name: Astropad Workbench
tagline: Remote desktop for AI agents running on headless Macs
description: Running AI agents on a headless Mac mini? You still need to see what's happening. Check logs, restart stuck tasks, monitor outputs. Workbench is remote desktop built for the AI era, so you can babysit your agents from anywhere, without being tethered to your desk. Apple-native, with voice dictation and low-latency streaming powered by LIQUID, our proprietary tech. Built by ex-Apple engineers.

name: zeeproc
tagline: Agentic Customer Success Platform for modern AI native teams
description: zeeproc is an autonomous AI agentic platform for customer success management that automates the full customer lifecycle, from onboarding through renewal. It reduces manual work for CSMs, standardizes execution at scale, and turns fragmented customer data into real-time, operational decisions rather than static reports.
